title: Is that her? asked miss Kennedy
html_source: Ms Douce and Ms Kennedy hear the viceroy’s carriage go by, Miss Kennedy sees it. This aligns itself with other contrasts present in Sirens- gold and bronze, near and far, eyes and ears.
